name: @builderforce/difficulty-router
description: The D2 difficulty router (PRD: LLM Cost Optimization Layer): will the WEAK model's attempt at this step fail its verifier? The feature contract the cascade records and asks with, the fixed feature scaling, the trust policy (min samples, held-out loss below a coin, skip threshold) as data, the binary head a trained logistic model reduces to, and the prediction. Pure, dependency-free and I/O-free: the trainer is injected (the api passes the engine's `trainMlTask`), so no second logistic trainer exists.
